scope: PARTIAL, per-function approval. Simple pair bench inside the full game with a loaded save (original with the class hooks off vs candidate with the hooks on), 27616 isolated CPU pairs for 55 functions of CClothesBuilder (14), CShadows (19) and CWaterLevel (22). Only the 52 functions whose pairs are ALL equal and whose pair count equals the bank table are registered (CClothesBuilder 14, CShadows 19, CWaterLevel 19); the run as a whole has passed=false because CWaterLevel::AddWaterLevelQuad (254/1024), RenderFlatWaterRectangle (472/1024) and SplitWaterTriangleAlongXLine (258/512) differ: they are REJECTED, not registered and get no credit. The run has no natural "complete" event: the bench writes "complete" only when passed, otherwise a terminal "error" event (pairs=27616, state_restored=true, no reason, i.e. the run finished normally); saves unchanged, configs restored. Each case rebuilds the same deterministic fixture in both legs (fake objects; drawing replaced by traces of RwIm3D*/RwRaster*/etc. with raw arguments, nothing is drawn) and compares return value, collaborator traces, the bytes of the real fields of the fixtures (padding masked), and the restored globals; x87 at 24 bits, no signalling NaN, foreign threads ignored (Mine()). Traced stubs and out-of-bench pieces get NO credit (e.g. GetFirstTexture, RwRaster*/RwTextureCreate, CStreaming/CDirectory/CTimer collaborators, CEntity::GetColModel, CPed::GetBonePosition, CCamera::IsSphereVisible, CRealTimeShadow::*, RwIm3DTransform/RenderIndexedPrimitive/End, LittleTest, RwTextureDestroy, CWorldScan::ScanWorld, GetWaterLevelNoWaves, AddWaveToResult, FindPlayerCoors, CanSeeWaterFromCurrArea, HandleBeachToysStuff, FindNearestWaterAndItsFlow and, per case, sibling CWaterLevel drawing functions). Fx_c::GetFxQuality is a stub fixed at quality 0 WITHOUT trace: the drawOnBuildings-by-FX-quality logic of StoreShadowForPedObject/StoreRealTimeShadow/StoreCarLightShadow and the dist==0 check of RenderExtraPlayerShadows (NOTSA) are not exercised and get no credit. Masked/controlled noise: CWaterVertex padding (copied by the EXE from stack garbage), CRenPar 2-byte padding, structure padding; AddWaterLevelQuad kind 9 uses two Y levels (the EXE reads uninitialised stack); NumLights fixtures 0..6 (uint32 in the DLL vs signed int in the EXE); MAX_DISTANCE_PED_SHADOWS_SQR (0xC4B6B0) is a variable in the EXE vs constexpr 225 in the DLL; Clothes only coherent raster sizes (w*h<=36, 32 bits), so the DLL AssertTextureLayouts and the SOURCE/DEST pixel-count difference are not exercised. OUT of the bank and without credit: CClothesBuilder::CreateSkinnedClump (streaming of PLAYER.IMG and real RW objects), CShadows::RenderStoredShadows and CastPlayerShadowSectorList (real world sectors and pool nodes), CWaterLevel::WaterLevelInitialise (water.dat + sscanf), RenderBoatWakes (inlined pass over boats) and SplitWaterTriangleAlongYLine (source does not yet equal the 4 EXE branches). Only the own part of each function is validated. Source corrected to what the EXE does before the run (uncommitted at the time; see reversing/GfxWave2/notes_Cl.md, notes_Sh.md, notes_Wl.md for addresses): see source_corrections_before_run. WARNING: source/game_sa/WaterLevel.cpp was modified in the working tree AFTER the approved run (see source_changed_after_run); the registry keeps the hash that was TESTED, so source_match is false for the CWaterLevel entries until that file returns to the tested state or is re-validated. Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation.
